open.name: Open
open.description: Controls whether the select dropdown is open.

defaultOpen.name: Default Open
defaultOpen.description: Whether the select is initially open (uncontrolled).

modal.name: Modal
modal.description: Whether the select popup is modal, preventing interaction with the rest of the page.

alignItemToTrigger.name: Align Item to Trigger
alignItemToTrigger.description: Whether the selected item inside the popup is aligned to the trigger element.
